baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11 form a motion-after-disclosure chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return, rear-facing withdrawal, temporal succession, disclosure, and path-direction combine into an embodied U-turn: the walkers cross a clarity threshold and then reverse along an already indicated route.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior place or state supplies the mechanism's backward vector.
The rear or back gives the reversal a bodily orientation.
Turning the back and withdrawing converts position into refusal.
Succession after a prior event makes disclosure the threshold already crossed.
Appearance and uncovering establish that the route was not hidden.
Gentle direction toward a path or truth supplies the intended route.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a generic loss of belief after receiving information.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a deliberate U-turn on an already disclosed route; the fault is reorientation after recognition, not simple absence of evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rear-facing noun at word 5 is set against the guidance noun at word 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The leading-edge branch makes guidance something ahead that leads, while the rear branch and return verb make the subjects exchange that lead for their own backs.

activation_trace.role: A guide or leading forepart places guidance ahead of those being led.
The back or rear supplies the opposed bodily pole.
Return changes the front-to-back contrast into actual reversed motion.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is information that the subjects later reject.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is also a leading position or vanguard that they cease to follow, so retreat is a broken relation to what had gone ahead of them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The agent, embellishment verb, and extension verb at words 12, 13, and 15 form a two-stage causal clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: A remote, defiant tempter beautifies the option already wanted, then stretches the interval in which that valuation can operate. Desire and duration reinforce one another.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance characterize the agent's alienating effect.
Defiant rebellion gives the agent an oppositional mode rather than a neutral persuasive role.
Making falsehood look attractive supplies the revaluation step.
A wanted need or wish makes the persuasion appetite-congruent.
Extended time gives the altered valuation room to persist and repeat.
The second mapped inventory likewise supplies respite and added duration as active support.

changed_reading.before: The final clause says only that Satan deceives them and gives them time.
changed_reading.after: Temptation works as desire-congruent revaluation backed by temporal runway; delay is part of the mechanism, not neutral aftermath.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the bodily back into a failure of consequence-reading: directed observation should reach the end of an affair, but deliberation closes just before the subjects turn away.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight supplies the act needed to perceive consequences.
The end or outcome defines what observation is meant to reach.
Looking into how an affair ends turns the shared root into an explicit practice of consequence-reading.
Closure and rigidity block that practice at the level of the heart.
Return from a journey adds a secondary closed-itinerary echo to the reversal.
The focus use converts failed deliberation into enacted withdrawal.

structural_cues: 47:10 orders movement through the land, directed looking, and the outcome of predecessors.
47:24 places deliberation and heart-locking immediately before 47:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies looking at outcomes, deliberation, closure, and then backs; I infer that bodily turning back enacts refusal to inspect consequences. A live alternative is simple withdrawal without a deliberate echo between the two uses of the shared root.

changed_reading.before: The turn is a directional reversal after clarity.
changed_reading.after: The turn is also anti-deliberation: they substitute presenting the back for looking through the matter to its end.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear evidence and beautified wrongdoing operate as competing valuation regimes. Hearing can occur, yet desire supplies the tilt that makes the disclosed route unattractive and the harmful alternative appealing.

activation_trace.role: Attractive presentation is the focus mechanism whose context is being sharpened.
Visible clarity supplies the explicit pole opposed to beautification.
Presenting something as beautiful supplies the contextual twin of the focus embellishment.
The inclination of desire explains why the beautified option gains traction.
The branch joining hearing to understanding and compliance exposes the gap between auditory reception and enacted response.

structural_cues: 47:14 directly contrasts clear evidence with a beautified bad action and followed desires.
47:16 places renewed desire-following after an episode of listening without retained understanding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, beautification, desire, and failed responsive hearing; I infer that the focus persuasion changes felt value more than available evidence. A live alternative is ordinary doctrinal deception with no distinct appetitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Satan hides or contradicts what had become clear.
changed_reading.after: Clarity may remain cognitively available while desire-driven beautification reverses its practical value, allowing retreat without erasing recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere in the context guidance repairs the inner condition and increases for those already oriented. The focus reversal therefore interrupts a cumulative feedback process rather than merely discarding a static datum.

activation_trace.role: Active direction toward the route makes guidance an ongoing process.
Repair against corruption supplies an inward consequence of continued guidance.
The paired occurrences couple prior orientation with further direction.
Increase and growth make the guidance process self-reinforcing over time.
Placing oneself under protection supplies the strengthened disposition produced along the route.
Return marks the focus interruption of that cumulative movement.

structural_cues: 47:17 repeats the guidance root on both sides of an explicit increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance linked to repair and to increase; I infer a positive feedback path that the focus subjects exit. A live alternative is that the earlier and focus instances describe unrelated gifts rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: They abandon a completed delivery of guidance.
changed_reading.after: They exit a living trajectory in which accepted direction would repair, protect, and generate further direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clarity becomes unstable at the transition from heard speech to a decisive, costly command. Aversion then converts full response into a secret bargain for partial obedience, giving desire and delay a concrete behavioral outlet.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the threshold whose practical cost the context reveals.
Decisive precision makes the revealed demand resistant to evasive reinterpretation.
Weakening and restricted movement model the incapacity exposed by the costly demand.
Resolved commitment identifies the point where agreeable speech must become action.
Aversion opposed to satisfaction supplies the affective bond with the rejecting audience.
Obedient compliance is explicitly narrowed by the surrounding partial construction.
Concealment in the interior makes the compromise covert before it becomes visible.

structural_cues: 47:20-21 moves from requested revelation to a decisive demand and then to the need for truthful action.
47:26 immediately explains the focus behavior through promised obedience in only part of the matter and hidden communication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decisiveness, weakened response, resolved action, aversion, partial obedience, and secrecy; I infer that retreat occurs when clarity becomes binding and a selective-obedience bargain offers relief. A live alternative is general hypocrisy without a specific cost threshold.

changed_reading.before: Retreat follows clarity for an unspecified reason.
changed_reading.after: Retreat is triggered when clear speech hardens into costly commitment, and it is operationalized as covert, partial obedience to an averse constituency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same directional failure expands from personal retreat into obstructing a traversable way, turning away from obligations, severing bonds, and splitting the community through opposition.

activation_trace.role: Turning away and diverting others converts private orientation into active blockage.
A path extended for travel gives the obstruction a shared spatial object.
Turning one's back and withdrawing supplies the contextual transition from orientation to conduct.
Severing a connection supplies the social consequence of withdrawal.
The later recurrence repeats active diversion beside the focus clarity sequence.
The repeated route links the later obstruction directly to the focus's directional field.
A group split by conflict supplies the public form of the retreat.
The focus back-turn remains the bodily anchor for the expanded social mechanism.

structural_cues: 47:32 nearly repeats the focus sequence of succession, disclosure, and guidance while adding path-obstruction and opposition.
47:22 makes turning away the condition for corruption and broken kinship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated obstruction, turning away, severance, and schism around a near-repeat of the focus clause; I infer an outward trajectory from private retreat to collective opposition. A live alternative is that these are parallel behaviors of different groups rather than stages of one trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an inward lapse by individuals.
changed_reading.after: The inward U-turn is a seed of public alignment: it can divert others from the route, break relations, and harden into organized opposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distributes commitment over a body-axis: feet are stabilized for forward action, guidance occupies the lead, backs mark chosen retreat, and faces plus backs later become exposed together.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening and fixing supplies the opposite of unstable retreat.
The foot supplies the literal bodily base of committed movement.
Advancing toward the front turns fixed feet into directional commitment.
The face and front provide the body-axis pole opposite the back.
The repeated back completes the later front-rear exposure.
The leading forepart of guidance gives the body-axis a forward destination.

structural_cues: 47:7 fixes feet, 47:25 chooses backs, and 47:27 pairs faces with backs.
The three scenes move from enabled forward stance to chosen reversal to involuntary total exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed feet, a leading guide, chosen backs, and later face-back exposure; I infer a mirrored bodily sequence in which consequence overtakes the chosen orientation. A live alternative is recurrent body imagery without punitive mirroring.

changed_reading.before: The mention of backs is an idiom for retreat.
changed_reading.after: The back belongs to a distributed body-map of commitment: stabilized feet should advance behind the lead, whereas chosen rearward orientation culminates in exposure of both front and back.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended time creates a felt open horizon even though signs and reminder are already present and the endpoint arrives suddenly. Reprieve therefore sustains false security rather than supplying new evidence.

activation_trace.role: Temporal extension supplies the apparent open horizon.
Respite in the second mapped inventory reinforces delay as an active lure.
Waiting for a time and granting respite link expectation to delay.
Sudden arrival closes the horizon that respite appeared to extend.
Advance signs establish that warning preceded the sudden close.
A reminder that prompts recollection shows what delay does not newly provide.

structural_cues: 47:18 places prior signs before a sudden arrival and asks what use reminder will have at that point.
47:25 likewise places clarity before extension of time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies waiting, respite, prior signs, reminder, and sudden arrival; I infer that added time is misread as evidence that the horizon remains open. A live alternative is simple postponement of response without any felt assurance.

changed_reading.before: Added time merely postpones the consequence of retreat.
changed_reading.after: Added time manufactures false temporal confidence: because the interval continues, the retreat feels sustainable even though disclosure is complete and closure may be sudden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The extended interval also functions as incubation: concealed orientation acquires visible marks, leaks through slanted speech, and becomes knowable under testing and pressure.

activation_trace.role: Extended duration supplies the interval in which latent orientation can ripen and leak.
Causing something to be seen supplies the possibility of direct disclosure.
Recognition from a trace or sign turns latent condition into readable evidence.
A visible mark indicating condition supplies the outward leak.
Speech tilted toward an implication supplies an audible leak of hidden alignment.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the pressure that exposes latency.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies the endpoint of exposure.

structural_cues: Branchless cue only: 47:29 has root ض غ ن at word 11 as a concealed condition expected to be brought out.
Branchless cue only: 47:37 repeats root ض غ ن at word 6 after an insistent demand extracts what was hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies duration, visible signs, revealing speech, tests, and branchless repeated hidden rancor; I infer that extension can become an incubation-and-exposure interval. A live alternative is that the focus delay is solely Satanic postponement while later disclosure belongs to a separate testing process.

changed_reading.before: The extension only allows the false choice to continue.
changed_reading.after: The extension can also let a latent reversal consolidate until marks, tone, and pressured choices make the hidden orientation legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the writing/dictation branch of the final focus verb rather than its ordinary temporal branch. It remains anchored by the focus sequence of disclosure, embellishment, and that verb, and context supplies negotiated speech plus revealing intonation. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary counter-script image, not replace the temporal reading or claim a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The disclosure, embellishment, and final verb at words 9, 13, and 15.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the first readable account.
Attractive presentation supplies the revision imposed on that account.
Dictating writing supplies the image of a replacement script.
The second mapped inventory independently preserves the dictation image.
Negotiating an affair gives the counter-script a social voice.
Speech bent toward its implication makes the adopted script audible in tone.

changed_reading.before: The final verb extends time for an already completed deception.
changed_reading.after: Alongside extension, the clause can evoke a beautified counter-script dictated over clear disclosure and then voiced as negotiated, slanted speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped inventory for the focus return root. It remains packet-valid and anchored to the return verb, while the focus agent's defiant branch supplies a visible relation. Downstream prose must label it a split-root activation about attrition and hardening, not an etymology of the surface form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The return verb at word 3 and the named agent at word 12.

activation_trace.role: Being stripped of good until hardened in defiance supplies an attritional state behind the retreat.
Defiant rebellion aligns the tempter with the hardened state activated by the split mapping.
Prior disclosure keeps the hardening tied to resisted clarity rather than original ignorance.

changed_reading.before: Turning back is a discrete directional act.
changed_reading.after: The split-root activation lets the act cast an attritional shadow: retreat after clarity strips away receptivity and rehearses the tempter's own defiant mode.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain body-and-pasture model is surprising because it joins a sagging lower structure, a support against falling, prolonged time, and the repeated collapse root's harmful-feeding branch. It remains anchored to the focus embellishment, extension, and reversal while context repeatedly supplies deed-collapse. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for deceptive flourishing, never a literal physiological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reversal, embellishment, and extension positions at words 3, 13, and 15.

activation_trace.role: Sagging or slackness in a lower part supplies loss of structural tension beneath the attractive surface.
A prop that prevents falling supplies the support being lost in retreat.
Extended time allows deceptive expansion to look stable.
Swelling caused by harmful intake supplies growth that is apparent but ruinous.
Descent and falling supply the eventual outcome of that false expansion.

changed_reading.before: Beautification makes a bad choice look good until its deeds are later lost.
changed_reading.after: The process can be pictured as toxic growth: harmful intake swells appearances during a long reprieve while supports slacken, ending in collapse rather than nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the threat branch from the non-dominant mapping of the focus guidance root. It remains anchored by retaining the dominant direction branch and by context where a decisive demand evokes a death-like response. Downstream prose should say clear guidance is experienced under a threat-shadow when it becomes costly, not claim that guidance lexically means threat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The guidance noun at word 11, held together with its prior disclosure at word 9.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward path and truth preserves the ordinary anchor of the focus noun.
Threat and fear from the split mapping supply the affective shadow cast when direction becomes costly.
A decisive, tightly formed demand supplies the moment guidance acquires practical force.
Loss of life and force supplies the fear-image elicited by that demand.
Return supplies the retreat made when direction is experienced as threat.

changed_reading.before: The subjects retreat despite recognizing guidance.
changed_reading.after: A split-root shadow suggests why recognition need not produce advance: once guidance becomes decisive and costly, they experience its demand as threat and flee the very direction they know.

strongest_changes: The back-turn becomes anti-deliberation because the immediately prior shared root calls for reading an affair through to its outcome.
Temptation changes practical valuation through desire and sustains that change with time, without needing to erase cognitive clarity.
The retreat occurs at the threshold where clear speech becomes costly action and is expressed as covert, partial obedience.
A near-repeat later expands the private U-turn into path-obstruction, social severance, and collective schism.
Added time can create false temporal confidence and can also let hidden orientation become visible under testing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates route, body, cognition, appetite, and time into one reversal. Context does not collapse these into one explanation: it preserves a consequence-refusal reading, a desire-and-delay reading, a costly-command reading, a social-opposition reading, and several explicitly contained split-root or material activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not force one causal priority among failed deliberation, aversion to cost, desire, and social alliance.

The extension can be read primarily as Satanic postponement, false confidence, or an interval in which hidden orientation becomes exposed; these mechanisms can coexist but their directional arrows are reader-supplied.
The public-opposition trajectory may connect stages of one group or may align parallel descriptions of different groups.
Non-dominant mapped-root and cross-domain outliers remain activation images and should not be promoted to lexical glosses.
